changes: Derived from functional-red-black-tree 1.0.1 with its persistent path-copying insert and removal, node layout and property enumerability.
at() returns an invalid iterator for an empty tree or any index that is not an in-range integer, instead of throwing or treating NaN as zero.
A truthy non-function comparator throws at construction instead of on the second insert.
Iterative keys, values and forEach traversal with range pruning; the four range lookups share one search routine.
Self-contained declarations, with nullable nodes; CommonJS and native ESM default entries.
